$comment: A C++ source with Kotlin code in it (Kompoz's kompozable): C++ (VS Code's own grammar) but for its Kotlin declarations, at the start of a line. A Kotlin region begins at a line only Kotlin starts (an annotation, fun, val, var, object, data class, a class with a constructor...) and ends before a line at the start that doesn't go on with Kotlin (#include, TEST(, a C++ class), once its braces are closed. What only kompozc tells apart (class X { in either) is left as C++ here.
